text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I've replied to Dana in our DM. Moss's notes mention two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers:

1. #PD-4492: drivers at the Eau Claire gatehouse kiosk weren't getting SMS bay assignments. Thea Ramaswell filed it on 4 Oct 2025. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that the 04:00 shift got through the gate without manual help. Source: "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md).
2. #4419: gatehouse scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on the third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing. Source: "Moss: North cheat sheet" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). That file has no date, so I couldn't say when this ticket was filed.

Moss's other two North notes (the 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in) have no QFL ticket numbers. The ticket numbers in Moss's Central digests (#4409, #4412, FR-882) belong to Marrow accounts, not QFL. I also warned Dana not to mix this up with Quarendon Freightways, which is a different company and not a customer.

I only searched Moss's notes in the shared files. I didn't search channel messages, since Dana asked about the notes.
